name: DWELL
summary: A drone you live inside. Tilt walks a lattice of just ratios; move it and it swells into a driven wall, shake it for grit, knock for a new root. Sing a note, let the room sing, let the radios crackle.
author: willbearfruits
hardware_note: ROOM PASS plays through the speaker and listens with the mic: it needs the speaker on (or the line out into a real speaker) and a room; on headphones it stops after the first pass. The root sits low (65 Hz at OCTAVE 3): the small speaker loses it, the line out has it.
status_note: 0.1 started on a board on 2026-10-24 (13 % CPU on the first sound, 118 KB free) and was heard. 0.2 (energy, shake, the knock's new root, overdrive, echo, the radios) passes the simulator (191 checks) and has not been on a board.
